title: Annoying questionnaires which is impossible to skip
body:
Having Pro plan you have to answer a lot of questions before you can even start using the app - I mean you open it to see your current routines but the app decided you have to answer the questions AGAIN - it’s annoying and frustrating, questions loop, I do NOT recommend 
Why devs do not add a “skip” button? This so-called “personalization” is useless

title: My pace maker
body: Excellent tool to keep me going

body: I tried to sign in with my google and apple account multiple times but I wasn’t successful. Then I tried to sign up and make an account using my email address but it showed the message internal error. It is frustrating. I wasn’t able to use the application at all which is why I am going to delete it.

title: No Timer mode
body:
FAO Developer: (update)

I still cannot add the timer to the routine. When I try to edit the routine it only gives me the option to change the name, update the habits or the color. Nothing to do with the timer. Thanks. And at the moment my account is PRO (trial)

I downloaded this because according to the screenshot it had a timer / focus mode. But it doesn’t seem to at all. The app is ok, but 1 star because I wasted a lot of my free time with it and it was pointless.
author: appleidnac

title: Truly Amazing! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
body: Incredible app! I don’t know what’s up with some commenting about why there is a premium option and not only a free tier. Clearly they have no idea about the expenses and the hours that app developers have to put into to achieve such great results! As a fellow app developer myself, I want to thank you for your very generous free tier and incredibly cheap subscription. This app is one of the bests on the store! 🙏
author: GoldenPhoenix108

title: Why should people have to pay?🙄😡
body:
The app is really good and I use it in my everyday routine but you shouldn’t have to pay to go unlimited because some people don’t have the money to pay like kids who need to build a better routine to get more active so I politely request that you and the creator of this app Will not ask people to pay because some people can’t
Thank you, X
author: 𝒸ℴ𝓃𝓃ℴ𝓇

title: It’s good but you can’t do practically anything without paying
body: It’s not free at all

title: Absolute game-changer!
body:
This app has honestly been life changing for me. It has helped me create new habits and stick to them consistently for the first time ever. My routines have drastically improved. It’s one of the only apps I have not given up on. 
It’s made such a difference to my health! Can’t recommend it enough!
author: Sara Emily …

title: Confusing
body: I just wanted a simple app where I tell it what habits I want to create, it reminds me, I tick when I’ve achieved & I get stats telling me how well I’m doing (or not). Nope!  Sooo confusing! I set up a routine but it ended up with extra steps in it that I didn’t add. The app nags me constantly to do things but it doesn’t appear to allow me to tick anything off! Pointless!
author: JustmeinDevon

title: Huh?
body: I followed the intro and all the instructions through the steps, but it made no sense to me. I tried ticking off tasks I’d completed but it removed ten tasks forever so I’d have to waste time relishing for the next day? I don’t know. I couldn’t figure it out and it’s stressful enough masking all day without having app that’s not user friendly stressing me out even more, so it’s deleted and gone. I need something simple and straight forward and this is not
author: aliray

title: kinda bad…
body:
It’s a great app and all but I’ve downloaded it to make a daily routine but I can only add 10 things to do in a day for free… 

To improve maybe make more things you can do for free.  
Other than that it is an amazing app!
author: Anonymouse797

title: Finally
body: I’ve bounced between habit trackers for years..always gave up after a week. This one’s different. Feels light, not bossy, and actually helps me get on with things. I’ve used it daily for over a month now, which says a lot.
author: CoyleEspinaly

title: Keeps me ticking
body: I used to set goals and forget them the next day. This app keeps me gently nudged in the right direction. It's the quiet accountability I didn’t know I needed
author: Willard Penny

title: No more drifting
body: I’m a bit of a serial app-hopper, but I’ve stuck with this one. The UI is pleasant, and the pacing feels human—not like I’m failing if I miss a task.
author: Razo_Breannae

title: Surprisingly helpful
body: Started using this during a chaotic work season, and it’s been a small anchor in my day. I don’t always get everything done, but at least I know where I’m heading
author: Radford_Choatey

title: Great app!
body: I tried lots of similar apps, but this one just works for me. Not even sure why. Can recommend for sure
author: dan—sh

title: App Does Not Load
body:
I enjoy using the app for my daily schedule. I have a widget on my home screen which keeps me up to date with scheduled tasks. 

However, when I click on the app either through the widget or directly it doesn’t load. This has happened on most occasions I tried to access the app, only occasionally I get access to check my daily progress and compare different days. I have subscribed but considering changing to a different app as I can’t use this effectively.
author: Shabanaxo

title: Review !
body:
Hi ! I just wanted to say that this is a great app to plan your routines and is really easy to use ! The way you can highlight the thing to do in either yellow or pink (more if you pay) makes the display look really colourful and fun . Along with the emojis you choose for each task . 

If i were to have any feedback, it would be to let people do a little bit more for free but I totally understand if you can’t . 

Overall it’s a really useful and fun app - 5 stars !
Thank you!
